_doc: UI-test av Kartrummets steg Sculpt (tools/studio/ui_test.py): Green isle, penseln Raise (ett riktigt musdrag), Undo, en å som klickas fram och grävs, en vik via receptet, Spara med skulpteringen och vattnet, Clear sculpting och ladda tillbaka. Sparar världen ui_test_sculpt i assets/terrain/; ta bort den efteråt.
name: sculpt

steps.label: the Sculpt step opens in the shaded view
the drawer has six brushes and three kinds of water
with a brush the left button sculpts
a Raise stroke lifts the land
the footer says the world is shaped
the river line has four points

steps.expect: (() => { const s = __studio.terrain.channelInfo[0].smp; return s.length > 20 && s.every((p, i) => !i || p.level <= s[i - 1].level + 1e-6); })()
steps.label: the river is dug and its surface only runs downhill

steps.expect: (() => { const f = __studio.terrain.field, s = __studio.terrain.channelInfo[0].smp, p = s[Math.floor(s.length / 3)], h = __studio.terrain.vals.worldSize / 2, i = Math.round((p.x + h) / f.cell), j = Math.round((p.z + h) / f.cell); return f.heights[j * f.n + i] < p.level; })()
steps.label: the river bed lies under the water
the river has a water surface

steps.expect: (() => { const f = __studio.terrain.field, h = __studio.terrain.vals.worldSize / 2, i = Math.round((0.01 * 1024 + h) / f.cell), j = Math.round((0.3 * 1024 + h) / f.cell); return f.heights[j * f.n + i] < -1; })()
steps.label: the bay is dug under the sea

steps.expect: fetch('/api/terrain').then((r) => r.json()).then((d) => { const x = d.saved.find((s) => s.name === 'ui_test_sculpt'); return x?.channels?.length === 2 && x.channels[0].kind === 'river' && (x.layers?.sculpt?.length ?? 0) > 50; })
steps.label: Save stores the sculpting and the dug water
Clear sculpting goes back to the generated world
loading the world brings the sculpting back
